description: 3P update workflow mapped into typed steps. Each step writes one artifact so it can be checked on its own.

steps.source_section: SKILL.md > How to use this skill > 1. Identify the communication type / 2. Load the appropriate guideline file
steps.description: Decide which kind of internal communication is being requested and which guideline file applies.
Confirm the team name and time periods with the user. Replayed from a recorded decision in automated runs.

steps.source_section: examples/3p-updates.md > Tools Available / Workflow > 2. Gather information
steps.description: Collect the facts for each section. List anything you leave out under 'excluded' with a reason.

steps.source_section: examples/3p-updates.md > Workflow > 3. Draft the update / Formatting
steps.description: Write the 3P update from the gathered facts, in the exact format from the guideline.
Check the draft against the strict 3P format with a script.
